name: query_database
description: Run a READ-ONLY SQL query against the project's Postgres database (SELECT, EXPLAIN, etc.) — the Floot-managed database, or an external Postgres the user connected to the project. Writes are rejected — use execute_sql for those. Returns JSON: `{rows, rowCount, command, truncated?}` (or `{results: [...]}` for multi-statement queries). Pass `database` only if the project has more than one.
